name: kn-tax-system-reference
description: Start here for how the Saint Kitts and Nevis tax system is built, for 2026: the income tax charge and its s 3(3) exclusion of income of persons other than companies from 1 May 1980, company residence by management and control and permanent establishment (Act 12 of 2021: more than six months for construction, more than 183 days for services), who is assessed (companies, partnerships, trustees, representatives, unincorporated business tax persons), the currency rules (EC dollars for Inland Revenue taxes, any legal tender for customs), the year of assessment and basic year, and which authority runs what (Inland Revenue, Customs, Social Security Board, Federal and Nevis allocation). Routes rates and filing to the other Saint Kitts and Nevis skills. Trigger phrases include Saint Kitts tax system, St Kitts tax residence, St Kitts permanent establishment, Nevis tax, no personal income tax St Kitts.
